Overview.Name: Saritha Chigullapally
Overview.Food_Habit: I can eat one bite and stop
Overview.Goal: Looking better (appearance), Feeling energetic & confident, Reducing thyroid and acidity-related discomfort, Preventing/reversing health issues, Mental wellbeing & stress reduction

Meal_1: Option 1: Paneer bhurji (120 g) + lightly cooked vegetables
Option 3: RICE RAWA upma (~150 g) + paneer cubes (80 g)
Meal_2 (Main Meal): Option 1: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & paneer curry (120 g) & vegetable curry
Option 3: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & mixed vegetable curry + paneer cubes (80 g)
Meal_3 (Dinner - light): Option 1: Vegetable soup + paneer cubes (80 g)
Option 2: Curd rice (~150 g) + cucumber salad

Notes_and_Tips: Avoid very spicy, oily and deep-fried foods as they may worsen acidity.
Do not keep long gaps between meals as it can increase acidity and low energy.
Avoid tea or coffee on an empty stomach.
Morning sunlight exposure can support thyroid health, sleep quality and recovery.
Keep dinner lighter and finish it at least 2 hours before sleep.
For boredom eating, drink water or buttermilk first before taking extra snacks.
Consistent yoga, walking and meal timing will improve energy and body composition.
